fitness.help.bench: Tap SPACE repeatedly to lift the draining pressure bar. Holding the key does not help. More weight, accumulated fatigue and later repetitions need more taps.
fitness.help.run: Alternate A/D to keep speed inside the green pace band. The target changes with the terrain. Repeating one foot or sprinting too fast drains stamina.
fitness.help.box: Click either mouse button when the bouncing marker crosses the centre. You can wait for another pass, but only the first punch counts. Centre hits build your streak.
fitness.help.pull: Hold SPACE to pull up, then release to lower and recover grip. Correct balance with A/D. A full up/down cycle is required.
fitness.help.row: Hold W to build power, release inside the green band, then hold S for the recovery stroke. Overcharging or skipping recovery loses the repetition.
fitness.help.squat: Hold W to descend into the green depth zone, release to pause, then hold S to rise. Going too deep or skipping the bottom pause loses the repetition.
fitness.controls.bench: Tap SPACE repeatedly; holding does not lift.
